commands.help: requests, tasks and what waits for you
where the work stands and what happened (since: 7d, <n>d or YYYY-MM-DD)
what waits for you; with an id, that decision whole
release a delivery (it stays a draft)

approve a plan or an acceptance (a plan: --go-ahead <task key>, repeated, drops that task's derived waits); an effect is approved with its hash, in the terminal, on the page, or on a messaging app the project grants that effect's word (from a card that carried the whole text)
reject a plan, an acceptance or an effect
make a failed or blocked task ready again
cancel a request at any moment, even while a task of it runs: the run is ended and returns nothing, what it used so far is spent
stop one running task: its run is ended and returns nothing, the task is blocked, and retry resumes it
start a new request, whatever is open (--after <id> before the text: run it after that request)
